title: Telnet service is open
description: Telnet sends usernames, passwords and commands in plain text, so anyone on the network can capture them.
fix: Disable the Telnet service in the device's admin page and use SSH with key-based login instead.

title: FTP service is open
description: Plain FTP sends credentials and files unencrypted. Anonymous FTP access is a common misconfiguration.
fix: Use SFTP or FTPS instead, disable anonymous logins, and restrict access to trusted hosts.

title: SMB file sharing is reachable
description: SMB is a frequent target for ransomware and worm-style attacks when exposed beyond the machines that need it.
fix: Block port 445 from untrusted segments, disable SMBv1, and keep the operating system patched.

title: Remote Desktop (RDP) is reachable
description: RDP is heavily targeted by password guessing and exploit attempts.
fix: Restrict RDP to a VPN or jump host, require Network Level Authentication, and enable multi-factor sign-in.

title: VNC remote desktop is reachable
description: VNC often has weak or no password protection and may be unencrypted.
fix: Require a strong password, tunnel VNC through SSH or a VPN, and disable it if it is not needed.

title: Database port is reachable on the network
description: Databases exposed to the LAN are often configured without authentication or with default credentials.
fix: Bind the database to 127.0.0.1 or a private interface, enable authentication, and firewall the port.

title: UPnP/SSDP service is reachable
description: UPnP lets devices open ports on the router automatically, which can expose internal services to the internet.
fix: Disable UPnP in the router settings unless you rely on it, and review any port mappings it created.

title: Web admin or alternate HTTP port is open
description: Alternate web ports often host admin panels, which are targeted with default-password attacks.
fix: Confirm the service is needed, change any default admin password, and restrict access to trusted addresses.

title: Unencrypted HTTP is served
description: Traffic over plain HTTP can be read or modified by anyone on the network path.
fix: Enable HTTPS with a valid certificate and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

title: Outdated OpenSSH version
description: OpenSSH versions before 8.0 are old and lack several security fixes.
fix: Update OpenSSH to a currently supported release through your OS package manager.

title: Outdated Apache httpd version
description: Apache httpd before 2.4.50 has a known path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2021-41773) among other fixes.
fix: Upgrade Apache httpd to a currently supported 2.4.x release and apply vendor security updates.
